Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 14, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how EfficienSee, LLC ("EfficienSee", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, shares, and protects information when you use OrderOasis, including the web application, the iOS app, and related services (together, the "App").

OrderOasis is a business tool for licensed cannabis operators and their staff. It is used to manage wholesale orders, inventory, manifests, and team communication. Access is limited to users invited by an authorized administrator of a customer organization. It is not offered to the general public.

1. Information We Collect

Information from your Google account

If you choose Sign in with Google, we request only the standard sign-in scopes (openid, email, and profile). From Google we receive:

  • Your name
  • Your email address and whether it is verified
  • Your profile picture URL
  • A unique Google account identifier

We do not request access to your Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Contacts, or any other Google service data.

Information you or your organization provide

  • Account information: name, email address, role, and team membership assigned by your administrator.
  • Authentication data: sign-in credentials managed through Supabase Auth, and an optional hashed access PIN.
  • Operational data: orders, line items, customers, manifests, inventory, batch and compliance records, and chat messages you create or interact with.
  • Integration credentials: API keys your organization connects for LeafLink or Metrc. These are stored encrypted and used only to sync data on your organization's behalf.

Information collected automatically

  • Device data for notifications: push notification tokens, used only to deliver in-app alerts.
  • Diagnostic data: error logs and basic usage events used to keep the App reliable.

The App does not collect advertising identifiers, precise location, contacts, photos, microphone, or camera input.

2. How We Use Information

  • Authenticate you and link your sign-in to your OrderOasis profile.
  • Enforce role-based access within your organization.
  • Display your name and photo to teammates inside the App, such as on orders and in chat.
  • Sync orders, inventory, and manifests with LeafLink and Metrc for your organization.
  • Send real-time chat messages, team invitations, and push notifications.
  • Diagnose problems, secure the service, and improve performance and reliability.

We do not sell personal information, and we do not use it for advertising or marketing profiling.

3. Google API Services User Data

OrderOasis's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Specifically, for data we receive from Google:

  • We use it only to provide sign-in and to show your identity inside the App.
  • We do not transfer it to third parties, except as needed to provide the App (for example, our hosting provider), to comply with law, or as part of a merger or acquisition with notice to you.
  • We do not use it for serving advertisements, including retargeting or personalized ads.
  • We do not sell it, and we do not use it to determine credit-worthiness or for lending purposes.
  • We do not allow humans to read it, unless you give consent, it is needed for security or to comply with law, or it is aggregated and anonymized for internal operations.
  • We do not use it to develop, improve, or train generalized AI or machine-learning models.

4. How We Share Information

We share information only in these cases:

  • Within your organization: administrators and teammates in your organization can see your name, role, and the records you work on.
  • Service providers who process data for us under contract:
    • Supabase - authentication, database, file storage, edge functions, and realtime messaging.
    • Our web hosting provider - serves the web application.
    • Apple - push notifications and App Store distribution.
    • Google - Sign in with Google.
    • GIPHY - GIF search in chat. Only your search terms are sent to GIPHY.
  • Integrations your organization enables: LeafLink (orders, customers, inventory) and Metrc (state cannabis traceability).
  • Legal and safety: when required by law, regulation, subpoena, or a request from a state cannabis regulator, or to protect the rights, safety, or property of users or others.
  • Business transfers: in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, subject to this Policy.

5. Data Storage and Security

Data is stored in a Supabase Postgres database in the United States. Row Level Security limits each record to authorized users. Data is encrypted in transit with TLS and at rest with the provider's standard encryption. Credentials and integration keys are hashed or encrypted. API keys follow least-privilege principles. No system is perfectly secure. If you believe your account has been compromised, contact us right away.

6. Data Retention

We keep account and operational data while your organization's account is active, or as long as needed to meet legal, tax, and regulatory obligations. This includes state cannabis recordkeeping and traceability requirements. Diagnostic logs are kept for a limited period and then deleted. When an account is deleted, we delete or anonymize personal information within 30 days, except where we are legally required to keep it.

7. Your Choices and Rights

  • Access, correction, and deletion: email privacy@efficiensee.io or ask your administrator. We respond within 30 days.
  • Revoke Google access: remove OrderOasis at any time at myaccount.google.com/permissions. You will need to sign in again to use the App.
  • Notifications: turn off push notifications at any time in your device settings.
  • Sign out: you can sign out at any time from the Settings screen.

Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under state privacy laws. Contact us to exercise them. We will not discriminate against you for doing so.

8. Children's Privacy

The App is for adult employees of licensed cannabis businesses. It is not directed to anyone under 21. We do not knowingly collect information from minors. If we learn that we have, we will delete it.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post changes on this page and update the effective date. If changes are material, we will notify users in the App or by email.
